label: A phase parent with a nested anchor passes ANCHORS_VALID: orchestrator.ts:975-976 returns a pass before scanning anchors when the folder resolves to phase, while the v4.0.0.5 note says nested anchors are errors. Repro: SPECKIT_RULES=ANCHORS_VALID validate.sh /tmp/dr2-phase-parent --strict --json returns the parent status pass with 'Phase parent lean document set accepted'.

Gate 1's 'exit 1 with no rows is a clean no-hit' (AGENTS.md:51) cannot distinguish a stale index from a genuine absence. At this commit generate-trigger-index.mjs --check --json exits 1 with fresh:false and 36 missing documents, all under the 047 research packet; a lookup for 'spec kit core plan' returns only .skilled/skills/system-spec-kit/README.md at query-containment, not the 047 plan.md. The retrieval README:84 documents --check as report-only and never per lookup; the lookup emits manifestHash but no corpus hash or freshness flag.

Two anchor parsers disagree on nesting: orchestrator.ts:936 flags any different anchor opened inside another (except adr-NNN children), while spec-doc-structure.ts:588-620 flags only a repeated id already in the stack and accepts a different id nested inside another, returning overlapping bodies. CROSS_ANCHOR_CONTAMINATION skips without a routing payload (spec-doc-structure.ts:1291), so the divergence is latent until a routing-payload consumer runs.
ANCHORS_VALID verified on three fixtures: a nested anchor fails with 'opened inside' and exit 2; an inline-code quoted pair passes; adr-001 containing adr-001-child passes.
Retrieval exit codes match their headers: no-hit lookup 1, no prompt 2, missing index 2, stale --check 1 with fresh:false.

Commit and PR gates exist and match the v4.0.0.5 note: pre-commit:225-235 blocks template/editor fallback phrases and names SPECKIT_SKIP_PHRASE_LINT=1; changed-packet-validation.yml:166-287 compares head to the merge base, fails closed, and reports no regressions.
validate.sh exits 2 on a validation error, matching its help at validate.sh:82.
